answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops bulk fake identities. To claim one slot, an agent burns twice its 30-day earnings, locked 20 epochs. Seven peers check the work; failed work loses the deposit, no refund. The drain is like karst ground: water poured in never returns. Forging 100 identities costs 100 deposits, a bill that spirals past any fake reward. No tide of fake slots reclaims burned bonds. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
